name: powershell-editor-services

name: yt6801-dkms

name: ananicy-cpp-s6
reason: DISTRO_SPECIFIC: s6-rc service scripts for ananicy-cpp; Guix uses GNU Shepherd, not s6; no upstream URL; AUR-only inline scripts

name: keyd-openrc
reason: DISTRO_SPECIFIC: OpenRC init scripts for keyd; Guix uses GNU Shepherd, not OpenRC; keyd itself is already in Guix upstream

name: texlive-installer
reason: DISTRO_SPECIFIC: Arch pacman compatibility shim that tricks pacman into thinking texlive is installed; Guix has native texlive packages via (gnu packages tex)

name: wsl-hello-sudo-bin
reason: PLATFORM_SPECIFIC: WSL-only PAM module for Windows Hello authentication; requires Windows host with WSL environment and Windows Hello API

name: transgui-git

name: lib32-libxxf86dga
reason: MULTILIB_UNSUPPORTED: 32-bit build of Xorg XF86DGA extension library; Guix does not support multilib (lib32) builds

name: updpkgsrcs
reason: DISTRO_SPECIFIC: bash tool for updating git submodule source arrays in Arch PKGBUILD files; has no purpose outside Arch packaging workflow

name: roxybrowser-bin
